name: Washington
agency: DSHS Community Services Division (Health Care Authority runs the program)

period.description: You choose a 3-month or 6-month base period; if you do not choose, it is 6 months.

submission.description: Mail your bills and receipts to the DSHS Customer Service Center or bring them to your local Community Services Office. Send proof within 30 days after the base period ends.

notes: Bills do not have to be paid to count. They must show the date of service, the provider, and what you still owe.
A statement from your insurance showing possible costs does not count as a bill.
You can ask for a separate retroactive base period covering up to 3 months before you applied.
DSHS does not pay the part of the bills used to meet your spenddown. You still owe that part.
